summary: A floor for the width. Also controls how far flex and grid items can shrink.
details: Flex and grid items default to min-width: auto, which means "not smaller than my content". Setting min-width: 0 lets them shrink so text can wrap or truncate.

values.note: Lets flex/grid items shrink below their content.
Default; content-based minimum for flex/grid items.

gotcha: If a flex child overflows its parent, min-width: 0 on that child is usually the fix.
